name: dsir-gho
description: Discover and retrieve public WHO GHO health data with verified indicators and DSIR-compatible cleaning.

interface.shortDescription: Find and download WHO GHO data
interface.longDescription: Find WHO GHO indicators and retrieve public health statistics by country, region, year and verified dimensions. Export CSV and JSON with source details and completeness checks. Uses legacy by default and xMart when explicitly selected; no automatic source fallback. Requires Python 3.10+ and permitted HTTPS access. No R or hosted server is required. Local Phase 1 candidate; existing published archives and installed plugins are unchanged.
defaultPrompt: Show historical UHC service coverage for the Western Pacific Region.
Get measles reported cases in the Philippines since 2015.
Find WHO indicators for catastrophic health expenditure above 10%.
